# Leapsome | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| Positioning | People empowerment platform linking HRIS, performance, objectives, participation, learning and remuneration. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competing Border | Hong Kong ' s remuneration and local compliance are not core; modular portfolio offers are not transparent; implementation of successful performance system design is not just online software. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, award or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | Hong Kong remuneration and local compliance are not core; the modular portfolio offers are not transparent; and the implementation of successful performance-based system design is not just online software. |
